row: Cascade Chiropractic & Wellness is a trusted Southeast Portland chiropractor specializing in gentle Atlas Orthogonal care, car accident and injury treatment, myofascial release therapy, and medical massage. Our Eastside Portland clinic combines advanced chiropractic techniques with soft-tissue rehab to help patients recover faster, relieve pain, and restore whole-body wellness. Whether you’re healing from an auto accident, dealing with chronic pain, or seeking a long-term wellness partner, our team provides compassionate, personalized care for every patient. Visit our website at http://eastportlandchiropractor.com to learn more and schedule your appointment today.
